revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. Production engineering added a calibration wrinkle between A2 and B2. Each machine can still run under its own setup cost, but if both A2 and B2 are active in the same monthly plan, a 100-unit joint calibration burden is charged once. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
